symptom: A capable cloud worker could not serve the existing private diff-comment interface; cloud comment reads were always rejected before reaching the VM.
rule: Port Local behavior through a shared core, negotiate optional cloud support, and use only an already-connected exact owner for passive reads. Stopped or older peers must remain explicitly unavailable without waking or publishing an empty snapshot. See RULES.md sections 4 and 8 and docs/code-review.md.
